id: bench_e1f519db_1
namespace: bench
tasks:
- task_id: t4_daily_particulate_summary
  type: io.kestra.plugin.scripts.python.Script
  runner: PROCESS
  script: |
    import urllib.request
    import json

    source_url = "http://recorder:8090/source/open-meteo/particulate?run_id=e1f519db_1&attempt=0"
    sink_url = "http://recorder:8090/sink/e1f519db_1?attempt=0"

    response = urllib.request.urlopen(source_url)
    data = json.loads(response.read().decode('utf-8'))

    times = data["hourly"]["time"]
    pm25 = data["hourly"]["pm2_5"]
    pm10 = data["hourly"]["pm10"]

    # Group by date (first 10 chars of ISO timestamp)
    groups = {}
    for i, t in enumerate(times):
        date = t[:10]
        if date not in groups:
            groups[date] = {"pm25": [], "pm10": []}
        groups[date]["pm25"].append(pm25[i])
        groups[date]["pm10"].append(pm10[i])

    records = []
    for date, vals in groups.items():
        records.append({
            "date": date,
            "hours": len(vals["pm25"]),
            "pm2_5_max": max(vals["pm25"]),
            "pm10_max": max(vals["pm10"])
        })

    body = json.dumps(records)
    req = urllib.request.Request(sink_url, data=body.encode('utf-8'), headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(req)
